dev.effects: Starts one health-gated foreground Vite development instance with silently suppressed local mail and retained local data; --stop tears it down.

build.effects: Builds production Worker/assets with private settings isolated and restored exactly; records native source/output identity.

verify.effects: Runs the complete internal verification target; no deployment.

setup.effects: Builds Slate, applies local migrations, preserves private native settings and prepares native owner sign-in; stops the temporary app. No provider calls.

deploy.effects: Uses Base deploy-kit in the owner Cloudflare account, with health checking; --dry-run builds and validates locally with no provider requests.

dev-local-ai.effects: Starts loopback Slate development and a private-token local Codex evidence bridge using existing codex login; applies local migrations and retains local state. Optional SLATE_AI_MODEL defaults to gpt-6-astra. Inference sends authorized evidence to Codex; no hosted provider acceptance. Stops owned children on exit.

source-check.effects: Reads tracked source and retained comparison material; rejects source or migration drift; no deployment.

integration-sync.effects: Rewrites derived management resource recipe and provenance from actual source; review diff, stage and relock.

artifact.effects: Packages the emitted native build through the pinned Base schema-2 producer into a fresh output directory, with exact module/asset payload digests and SQL bytes. No deployment or admission.

export.effects: Writes a new owner-only complete local D1/R2 installation archive through Base portability, or exports an authenticated hosted installation with --target remote --origin and --session-file; requires current native owner coverage and fresh email proof. Excludes credentials, sessions and transient caches. Base deployment controller ledger remains a native inventory integration blocker.

import.effects: Validates and restores into an empty local installation after explicit confirmation; identities require fresh native sign-in and effect authority must be renewed. Remote transfer is unsupported.

cf-typegen.effects: Uses Wrangler to regenerate committed Worker binding declarations from local configuration; no deployment.

source-lock.effects: Records intentionally staged source identities and retained origin comparison snapshots; no deployment.

install.effects: Frozen dependency installation only; no setup or remote effect.

preview.effects: Builds changed production output and serves a fixed foreground Worker with silently suppressed local mail and retained local data; --stop tears it down.

reset.effects: After explicit confirmation removes only declared local state, settings and installer drafts; retains source, exports and deployment receipts.

release.effects: Runs Base release validation, scans and local clean-history export; never pushes or deploys.

doctor.effects: Read-only tool/configuration/state diagnostics; no provider requests.

describe.effects: Read-only command, flags, aliases, effects and state description.

check.effects: Read-only structural first-party contract validation before dependencies or configuration exist.
